scope: A small manually checked publisher-metadata catalog for family, community and landscape fiction. It is not a live market survey, current bestseller ranking, whole-book reading or measured prose corpus.
limitations: Page counts belong to the named edition; they do not establish prose word counts or length rules. Publisher descriptions and promotional labels are attributed publisher statements, not independently verified sales. Comparison relevance to a new manuscript remains an editorial hypothesis. No audience-size, demand, sales or universal prose claim is supplied.

entries.title: The God of the Woods
entries.author: Liz Moore
entries.publisher_synopsis_summary: A teenager disappears from an Adirondack camp owned by her family. Her brother vanished years earlier; the search exposes conflict between the family and the surrounding community.
entries.comparison_status: Potential family-and-disappearance comparison; relevance remains hypothetical.

entries.title: Burn
entries.author: Peter Heller
entries.publisher_synopsis_summary: Two long-time friends leave a remote Maine hunting trip and encounter violent political upheaval. Their effort to reach safety tests both survival skills and their relationship.
entries.comparison_status: Potential landscape-and-survival comparison; political dystopia differs from ordinary family mystery.

entries.title: The Hunter
entries.author: Tana French
entries.publisher_category: Suspense & Thriller; Crime Fiction; Literary Fiction
entries.publisher_synopsis_summary: An ex-detective's rural Irish life is disrupted by a teenager's returning father and a gold scheme. Protection, revenge and family loyalty pull the characters in different directions.
entries.comparison_status: Potential community-and-loyalty comparison; it is a sequel, not a direct standalone or length model.

entries.title: Small Things Like These
entries.author: Claire Keegan
entries.publisher_synopsis_summary: A coal merchant in an Irish town discovers something at a convent that confronts him with his past and the community's complicity.
entries.comparison_status: Potential compact-community-and-moral-choice comparison; literary positioning differs from a genre thriller.
